spec.description: Display an interactive JSON Schema form in the conversation and wait for the visitor. Use to collect or review structured data before an action. Return value is {status: submitted, data: ...} or {status: cancelled}. Never perform the requested action until submitted; after cancellation stop. Use a JSON Schema object with properties and required; title/description label the form. uiSchema can set textarea widgets and field order. Do not ask for credentials.

schema.description: JSON Schema for the form, root type object. Include property titles, types and validation.

formData.description: Initial suggested values, editable by the user.
